title: DEIA: Evidence-Grounded Crash Repair with Change-Aware Test Design for HarmonyOS ArkTS
abstract: arXiv:2611.14064v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mobile crash repair requires more than identifying a source edit. Developers must establish how the edit relates to the reported failure and whether the modified application can be built, launched, and exercised without disrupting valid behavior. In HarmonyOS applications, this assessment also depends on platform-specific packaging and runtime execution.   To address this need, we present DEIA, an evidence-grounded workflow for HarmonyOS crash repair. DEIA constructs a bounded source-evidence package, uses a large language model to propose content-anchored edits, and relies on a deterministic writer to materialize and check the patch. It derives fail-to-pass (F2P) obligations from the reported fault and pass-to-pass (P2P) obligations from the potential impact of the patch. A stage-level ledger links the patch, test obligations, runtime observations, and candidate-generation cost.   We evaluate DEIA on 30 repair tasks from 24 HarmonyOS ap

translated_title: DEIA：面向鸿蒙 ArkTS 的基于证据的崩溃修复与变更感知测试设计
translated_abstract: 移动应用崩溃修复不仅仅是确定源代码中的修改位置。开发者还必须弄清该修改与所报告故障之间的关系，并确认修改后的应用能够被构建、启动和运行，且不会破坏原本有效的行为。在鸿蒙应用中，这一评估还依赖于平台特定的打包方式与运行时执行。为满足这一需求，我们提出了 DEIA，一个面向鸿蒙崩溃修复的基于证据的工作流。DEIA 构建一个有界的源代码证据包，利用大语言模型提出内容锚定的代码修改建议，并依靠一个确定性的写入器来落实和检验补丁。它从所报告的故障中推导出“失败到通过”（F2P）的测试义务，并从补丁的潜在影响中推导出“通过到通过”（P2P）的测试义务。一个阶段级账本将补丁、测试义务、运行时观测结果以及候选生成成本关联在一起。我们在来自 24 个鸿蒙应用的 30 个修复任务上对 DEIA 进行了评估。
tldr: DEIA 提出了一个面向鸿蒙 ArkTS 应用的基于证据的崩溃修复工作流，通过有界源代码证据包、大语言模型内容锚定的修改建议、确定性补丁写入器，以及从故障和补丁影响推导出的 F2P/P2P 变更感知测试义务和阶段级账本，实现了可构建、可验证且成本可追踪的崩溃修复。
en_tdlr: DEIA is an evidence-grounded crash repair workflow for HarmonyOS ArkTS that combines bounded source-evidence packages, LLM-proposed content-anchored edits, and a deterministic patch writer with change-aware F2P/P2P test obligations and a stage-level ledger to reliably build, verify, and cost-track mobile crash fixes.
